text: The one breaking change this week is #14002: External File Storage now rejects any path segment that is "." or "..", so callers that pass relative segments get an error instead of acting on a parent folder. Other behaviour changes are mostly fixes. In finance and inventory, #14283 and #13503 stop prepayment line amounts drifting after partial invoicing, #14332 widens Item Application Entry variables to BigInteger to avoid overflow, and #14080, #13669 and #14138 correct production and subcontracting reversals. Localization fixes include India GST application posting order, an empty GST component lookup and import duty GST entries (#14008, #14009, #13243), the German VAT Report supplies field (#13807, #14133), Czech VAT Statement sign (#13868) and FatturaPA postal codes (#11660). Norwegian SAF-T gains 1.40 support in #13264. The Expense Agent gets approval fixes (#13978, #13992), longer mileage addresses (#13920, #13925) and corporate card selection (#13587). On AI, Sales Lines Suggestions and No. Series Copilot move to GPT-5.6 Ceres (#14198, #14307, #14059), and #14007 obsoletes Create Product Information with Copilot. Smaller items cover the Intrastat XML export speed-up (#13999) and Power BI deployment clearing (#14212, #14229). Expense Management objects become public in #14295 and #14335, and #14373 adds subcontracting receipt events. AL-Go adds token request retries in #2444.

issues: #13243 is described as 'GST posting order and lookups', but it fixed wrong GST and import duty entries when invoicing partly received purchase orders for Import and SEZ vendors. Reworded to cover #14008 (posting sequence), #14009 (empty component lookup) and #13243 (import duty entries).

Minor, left as is: 'longer mileage addresses' (#13920, #13925) is fair, since the fixes stop addresses over 50 characters from failing to save. #14335 also makes the corporate card objects internal, but grouping it under 'objects become public' is acceptable.
